_excludeComment: check-service-model.ts is excluded for the reason the tests are, and it is
the same reason: it imports @eddy/types and eddy-ios source, and Vercel
installs only missouri-float-planner/ — so neither resolves during a
production build. It is a local audit CLI and is never part of the deploy.
tsconfig.test.json DOES check it, and package.json runs it with
--tsconfig tsconfig.test.json so the path aliases govern tsx as well as
tsc. See the header in tsconfig.test.json for why that second half matters.
